article.linkText: Maryland visits No. 5 Ohio State in Big Ten matchup
article.story: Maryland (2-3) at No. 5 Ohio State (4-1), Oct. 10 at 4:15 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Ohio State by 34.5. Against the spread: Ohio State 4-1, Maryland 2-3. How to watch: BTN Key stats Ohio State Offense Overall: 514.4 yards per game (7th in FBS) Passing: 357 yards per game (2nd) Rushing: 157.4 yards per game (71st) Scoring: 42.2 points per game (14th) Ohio State Defense Overall: 267 yards per game (18th in FBS) Passing: 168 yards per game (24th) Rushing: 99 yards per game (25th) Scoring: 12.6 points per game (8th) Maryland Offense Overall: 424 yards per game (48th in FBS) Passing: 277.2 yards per game (30th) Rushing: 146.8 yards per game (88th) Scoring: 30.4 points per game (69th) Maryland Defense Overall: 335 yards per game (56th in FBS) Passing: 198.4 yards per game (57th) Rushing: 136.6 yards per game (66th) Scoring: 30.2 points per game (116th) Maryland ranks 114th in the FBS averaging 69.2 penalty yards per game, compared to Ohio State's 34th-ranked 48.6 per-game average. Maryland ranks 113th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on % of trips. Maryland ranks 107th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:23, compared to Ohio State's 41st-ranked average of 31:35. Team leaders Ohio State Passing: Julian Sayin, 1,530 yards, 13 TDs, 1 INT, 72.5 completion percentage Rushing: Bo Jackson, 353 yards on 66 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Jeremiah Smith, 823 yards on 44 catches, 9 TDs Maryland Passing: Malik Washington, 1,288 yards, 7 TDs, 6 INTs, 62.9 completion percentage Rushing: Iverson Howard, 211 yards on 52 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Chris Durr Jr., 461 yards on 42 catches, 4 TDs Last game Ohio State won 31-14 over Iowa on Oct. 3. Sayin led Ohio State with 324 yards on 20-of-27 passing (74.1%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. Ja'Kobi Jackson carried the ball 14 times for 72 yards and scored one touchdown. Smith had 11 receptions for 206 yards and two touchdowns. Maryland fell 48-23 to Nebraska on Oct. 3. Washington passed for 254 yards on 23-of-44 attempts (52.3%) with one touchdown and two interceptions. DeJuan Williams had 78 rushing yards on 10 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for zero yards. Durr had seven receptions for 149 yards and one touchdown. Next game Ohio State plays at No. 7 Indiana on Oct. 17. Maryland hosts Rutgers on Oct. 17.
